source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means (risk TRUE for role guest) or action approve; critical cases require deny. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90. Trusted means context partner with any role except guest; a trusted delete prefers review at priority 80. Action change in context internal prefers deny at priority 70. Role auditor and context sandbox prefers allow at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid allow. All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means (risk TRUE for role guest) or action approve; critical cases require deny.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90.
Trusted means context partner with any role except guest; a trusted delete prefers review at priority 80.
Action change in context internal prefers deny at priority 70.
Role auditor and context sandbox prefers allow at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.role == guest)) or (event.action == approve)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.context == partner) and (event.role != guest)

predicate UnknownRisk(event):
    event.risk == UNKNOWN

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = deny

rule UnknownExternal:
    when (UnknownRisk(event)) and (event.context == internal)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskDefault:
    when UnknownRisk(event)
    then prefer label = allow priority 90

rule TrustedDelete:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == delete)
    then prefer label = review priority 80

rule ChangeInInternal:
    when (event.action == change) and (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = deny priority 70

rule AuditorInSandbox:
    when (event.role == auditor) and (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = allow priority 40

rule TrustedForbidAllow:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = allow

rule OtherRoles:
    when event.role in {operator, auditor}
    then prefer label = review priority 1

deployment_description: Classify one structured event using the supplied compiled instructions. The allowed outputs are review, deny, allow, uncertain. These names are arbitrary symbols, so do not infer their meaning. Copy the output stated by the matching compiled instruction.
